source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Αυγούστου — «Όσιος Ψόης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The whole of the page is a distich and one sentence: he reposed in peace at prayer. No year, no place, no hymn of any kind. The name begins with a digraph the name sweeps fold badly, `ps-`, so the corpus was grepped for the Latin stem as well as read off the sweep before he was called new; the folders it returns are Kapsokalyvia and the like and none of them is a Psoes.
